sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the PC6/PC7 applicability, authoritative ship ownership, explicit vertical-side selection, inclusive 0–10 DEG all-angle condition with at least one supplied angle, and required I2.3.2.1 (iv) method.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the angle-derived inclusion logic: the current SPARQL constraint treats any one normalFrameAngle value in the inclusive 0–10 DEG range as sufficient to establish a vertical-sided bow. Require at least one supplied normalFrameAngle and require every supplied considered angle on the ship to be within 0–10 DEG before inferring verticalSidedBowForm=true; a mix such as 5 DEG and 20 DEG must not trigger that inference. Preserve the PC6/PC7 applicability branches, explicit vertical-side selection evidence, and the I2.3.2.1 (iv) method requirement.

Restrict both SPARQL targets to the authoritative ship owner by adding `?this a nltl:ship` to each target query; currently any node carrying PC6/PC7 polarClass data can be targeted. Preserve the corrected requirement that at least one normalFrameAngle is supplied and every supplied angle is within inclusive 0–10 DEG, along with the PC6/PC7 applicability branches, explicit vertical-side selection evidence, and the I2.3.2.1 (iv) method requirement.

Candidate faithfully encodes the PC6/PC7 applicability, authoritative ship ownership, explicit vertical-side selection, inclusive 0–10 DEG all-angle condition with at least one supplied angle, and required I2.3.2.1 (iv) method.
